response.overview: Over seven years ago, we embarked on a journey to do something new and ambitious: transform our investigative journalism into an animated rap-documentary, using a medium that could cross ages, borders, and backgrounds to reach an audience traditional reporting never could. The result is Rhapsody on the Outlaw Ocean, which brings to life more than a decade of offshore reporting into a film that merges journalism, animation, and music to illuminate one of the least understood spaces on Earth: the high seas. The rap lyrics and music were written by Will Segal, and the film was vocally performed by cast members of the Broadway musical Hamilton.
response.title: Rhapsody on the Outlaw Ocean
